αἰετὸς: ἀετός — eagle; masc. nom. sg., epic αἰετός (= Attic ἀετός)

αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourselves’ (χαίρετε δ’ αὐτοί ’and fare well yourselves’) · also masc. nom. pl. with a 1st-person subject: ’ourselves’ (αὐτοί τ’ ἀμβαίνωμεν ’and let us ourselves embark’)

αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼ … αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’you yourself’ (ὄφρα καὶ αὐτός ’so that you too yourself’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὐτῇσι: αὐτός — self; as a pronoun ’them’; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic αὐταῖς)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βασιλήων: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.
βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένος: γένος — stock, race, lineage, offspring; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after (blood and) lineage’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of εὔχομαι: ’descent, birth’ (γένος εὔχομαι ’I declare my birth’) · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’by birth’ (ἐξ Ἰθάκης γένος εἰμί ’I am of Ithaca by birth’)
γέρας: γέρας — privilege, honor, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
γίγνονται: γίγνομαι — become, come into being; pres. 3 pl.: ’they come to be’ (of creatures that exist upon earth) · also with ἐκ: ’are born from, spring from’ (ἔκ τε κρηνέων … γίγνονται ’are born from springs’)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γιγνώσκω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise, understand; pres. 1 sg.: ’I know’
γνοίης: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential after κε: ’you would come to know’
δέπαϊ: δέπας — cup; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted δέπαϊ, its ending sounded as a separate syllable (= Attic δέπᾳ)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; dat. sg.

δασσάμενοι: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic doubled σ (= Attic δασάμενοι)
δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
δόμονδε: δόμος — house; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’homeward’
δύη: δύη — woe, distress, pain; fem. nom. sg.
δύναμις: δύναμις — power, ability, strength; fem. nom. sg.
δύστηνον: δύστηνος — wretched, unhappy; masc. acc. sg.
δώμαθ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώμαθ’ = δώματα before a rough breathing)
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’gives, is to give’ (οἵ τ’ … βῶσιν καί σφι Ζεὺς … δώῃ)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὴν: δήν — for a long time, long; adv.
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), used as nom./acc. sg. · also δίδωμι ’give’: aor. subj. 1 sg., ’I may give’ (ἵνα τοι δῶ ’that I may give you’)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰδώς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν before a vowel) — in, on; + dat.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴα: ἐάω — allow, permit; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’allowed’
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εὐπείθεος: Εὐπείθης — Eupeithes, father of Antinous; masc. gen. sg.
εὔμαιος: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζώει: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. 3 sg.
θάνατόν: θάνατος — death; masc. acc. sg., enclitic accent before τε: ’death’ · also accented before the enclitic γε: θάνατόν γε ’death at least’
θέσαν: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’made’ (ἀνάπυστα θέσαν ’made known’)
θαύμαζον: θαυμάζω — marvel at, wonder at; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θρόνους: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; acc. pl.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’)
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
κέλονται: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; pres. 3 pl. mid., + inf.
κέρδεα: κέρδος — gain, profit; neut. acc. pl. κέρδεα, extended sense ’cunning, craft’
καθήμενον: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
κακότητι: κακότης — badness, misery, distress; fem. dat. sg.
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’evil’ (μή τι κακὸν … εἴη ’and may no evil be’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ῥάκος: ’vile’ (ῥάκος ἄλλο κακὸν ’another, a vile rag’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a finite verb: ’an evil’ (ἐπεὶ κακὸν ἔμπεσεν οἴκῳ ’since an evil fell upon the house’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενοίμην: ’a bane, an evil (to them)’
κακῷ: κακός — bad, base, ignoble; masc. dat. sg. · also of smoke: κακῷ … καπνῷ ’foul smoke’
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial or cognate with a finite verb: οὐ καλὸν ἔειπες ’you have not spoken well’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: ’a fine thing (to hear)’
κανέοισιν: κάνεον — basket; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατέθεντο: κατατίθημι — put down, stow away; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’stowed’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’)
κεῖνον: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg.
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κλισμούς: κλισμός — chair, seat (lighter than the θρόνος); acc. pl.
κοιρανέουσιν: κοιρανέω — be lord or ruler over, hold sway; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
κρέ: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρέ’ = κρέα)
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κύπελλα: κύπελλον — cup, drinking-vessel; neut. acc. pl.
λάϊνον: λάϊνος — of stone, stone; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic λίθινος)
λαερτιάδην: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.

μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ‘in the halls’
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεμάασι: μέμαα — be eager, be intent on, strive (perf. w/ pres. force); 3 pl. μεμάασι(ν): ’they are eager’

μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.

μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)

μοίρας: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. acc. pl.

μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.

μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’

μῦθος: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said; masc. nom. sg.
ναῖεν: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, have one’s home; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’dwelt’
νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (arises)’
νωμῶν: νωμάω — handle, ply, turn over (in the mind); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., contracted
ξείνιον: ξείνιον — guest-gift; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic (= Attic ξένιον)
ξείνους: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. acc. pl.
ξενίη: ξένιος — of a guest, of hospitality; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ξενία): ’hospitable’ (or the noun ’hospitality’)
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer only in neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
οἰχομένοιο: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone away; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), perfect sense: ’gone’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
οἵη: οἷος — of such a kind, such as; in a simile ’as’; fem. nom. sg.
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδόν: οὐδός — threshold; masc. acc. sg.: ’threshold (of old age)’, a figure for reaching it · also the literal threshold of a house (ὑπέρβη λάϊνον οὐδόν ’stepped over the stone threshold’)
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πέλειαν: πέλεια — dove, rock-pigeon; fem. acc. sg.
πέλονται: πέλομαι — be, become, prove to be; pres. 3 pl.
πίονας: πίων — fat, rich; masc./fem. acc. pl. (fem. usually πίειρα)
παιδὸς: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. gen. sg. (φίλης ... παιδός ’a dear daughter’) · also masc. gen. sg., ’son’ (παιδὸς ἐμοῖο ’my son’; τοῦ παιδὸς ἀγαυοῦ ’the noble son’)
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’) · also + acc., ’beside, contrary to’ (παρὰ μοῖραν ’beside what is fitting’)
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
ποθεν: πόθεν — from somewhere; indefinite enclitic adv. (accentless after εἰ), distinct from interrogative πόθεν ’from where?’
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολύφρονα: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg.
προκείμενα: πρόκειμαι — lie before, be set out; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’) · also a preposition + gen., ’from (the side of)’ (πὰρ Ταφίων ’from the Taphians’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σάμῃ: Σάμη — Same, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ) · also gen. of comparison: σεῖο … μακάρτατος ’more blessed than you’
σιάλους: σίαλος — fat hog, fattened pig; masc. acc. pl.
σκέδασιν: σκέδασις — a scattering, dispersal; acc. sg.
σοῖσιν: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
σπλάγχνα: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl. σπλάγχνα, the inner organs (heart, liver, etc.), entrails, tasted first at a sacrifice; neut. nom./acc. pl.
σπλάγχνων: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl., the inner organs, entrails; neut. gen. pl.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
σύας: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. acc. pl.
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τέθνηκε: θνῄσκω — die; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’is dead’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσειε: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish with μή: ’may he not bring to pass’
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο, governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’ (not by κίε) · also plain possessive gen. with a periphrasis (ἱερὴ ἲς Τηλεμάχοιο ’the might of Telemachus’, i.e. Telemachus himself) · also gen. governed by μεσσηγύς ’between’ (νηός τε καὶ αὐτοῦ Τηλεμάχοιο ’the ship and Telemachus himself’)
τηλεμάχου: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg.
τηλεμάχῳ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιαῦτα: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstr. pron./adj., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’such things’
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’ · also τοι, the affirming particle (ἀλλ’ ἦ τοι ’but truly’), as the grave-accented form τοὶ
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’when small’
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the fruits · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the nymphs and of the Sirens · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: fem. acc. pl. ’which’ (ἀπειλάων, τὰς … ἐπηπείλησε ’threats which he threatened’) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the swine · also fem. acc. pl. with ἄλλας, article-like: ’the others’ (τὰς δ’ ἄλλας ’and the other (portions)’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον)
τῳ: τις, τι — someone, anyone; masc./neut. dat. sg. (= τινί), enclitic: ’to anyone’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
υἷος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg., epic υἷος (= Attic υἱοῦ), gen. with ἐνιπλησθῆναι
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); masc. dat. pl.
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also predicate adjective: ’dear’ (φίλος ἦεν Ἰήσων ’Jason was dear (to her)’)
φεύγων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg.
φόνος: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. nom. sg.
φύντες: φύω — grow; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., used adverbially (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing
χαλεπόν: χαλεπός — hard, difficult, harsh; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate: ’(it is) hard’
χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’)
χείλεσι: χεῖλος — lip; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσι
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’ · also gen. pl., dependent on μνῆμα: ’of Helen’s hands’ (μνῆμ’ Ἑλένης χειρῶν ’a memorial of Helen’s hands’)
χλαίνας: χλαῖνα — a thick cloak, mantle; fem. acc. pl.
χρυσέῳ: χρύσεος — golden; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῷ)
ἀΐδαο: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god and realm of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἅιδου)
ἀγέροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic (= ἠγέροντο): ’gathered’
ἀγήνορας: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. acc. pl.
ἀγήνορες: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. nom. pl.
ἀγορήσατο: ἀγοράομαι — speak in the assembly; aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἀγορεύει: ἀγορεύω — speak, speak in assembly; pres. 3 sg.
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, declare; impf. 3 pl.
ἀεικέλιον: ἀεικέλιος — unseemly, shameful; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄλγος
ἀθέσφατοι: ἀθέσφατος — immense, beyond telling (traditional gloss, uncertain); fem. nom. pl. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with νύκτες
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθεμίστια: ἀθεμίστιος (= ἀθέμιστος) — lawless, without regard for right (ἀ- + θέμις); neut. acc. pl., as noun: ’lawless things’
ἀλάλησθαι: ἀλάομαι — wander; perf. inf., with perfect force shading to present: ’to be a wanderer, to go wandering’
ἀλέγουσιν: ἀλέγω — care for, heed (+ gen.); pres. 3 pl.
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
ἀλλοδαπούς: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; masc. acc. pl.
ἀμφίνομος: Ἀμφίνομος — Amphinomus, one of the suitors; masc. nom. sg.
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
ἀντίνοος: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, son of Eupeithes, a leading suitor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφικάνω: ἀφικάνω — arrive at, come to; pres. 1 sg., epic by-form of ἀφικνέομαι: ’I have come to’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλγεσι: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. dat. pl.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv. · also ’idly, to no purpose, without ground’ (ἄλλως … ψεύδοντ’ ’tell lies idly’)
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἄλσος: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. acc. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄφρονι: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. dat. sg.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμπάζετο: ἐμπάζομαι — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was heeding’
ἐμὴ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνόησα: νοέω — perceive, catch sight of, notice; aor. 1 sg., augmented
ἐνώμων: νωμάω — handle, ply, manage; impf. 1 sg.: ’I was handling’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξικόμην: ἐξικνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 1 sg., with κε, unreal past: ’I should have reached’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπιήνδανε: ἐπιανδάνω — please, be agreeable to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. (ἀνδάνω, augmented ἥνδανε)
ἐπιβουκόλος: ἐπιβουκόλος — one set over the cattle, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρικυδέα: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, splendid; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
ἐρύσαντο: ἐρύω — draw, pull; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they drew (the meat) off (the spits)’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐόντ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐόντ’ = ἐόντα), epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., predicate: ἑτοῖμα τέτυκτο ’had proved real, had come true’
ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔοικας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you are like’
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc.
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
ἔχευεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … ἔχευεν = ἐνέχευεν): ’poured in’ · also in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἔχευεν = κατέχευεν): ’poured down, shed’
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘holding’ · also with ἄλγεα, masc. acc. sg.: ’suffering, enduring’ (κρατέρ’ ἄλγε’ ἔχοντα ’beset by harsh pains’)
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came’
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, drive; impf. 3 pl.
ἧμιν: ἐγώ — I, we; dat. pl., epic ἧμιν (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to us’
ἰόντ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἰόντ’ = ἰόντα): ’as he went’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱστίη: ἱστίη — hearth, hearth-fire, household; fem. nom. sg., Ionic (= Attic ἑστία)
ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
ἴδιον: ἴδιος — private, one’s own; neut. nom./acc. sg., substantival, opp. δήμιον: ’a private matter’
ἴστω: οἶδα — know; perf. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it/him/her know’ (calling something to witness)
ἵκει: ἵκω — come upon, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth; adv. (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv. · also ’back, home again’, of return (οἴκαδ’ ὀπίσσω ’back home’)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη) · also neut. acc. sg. relative, referring back to a thing, object of δῶκας: ’which (you gave me)’ · also = ὅτι ’that’, neut. acc. sg., introducing a clause after a verb of knowing (ὃ δὴ κακὰ μήδετο ’that evils were being devised’) · also neut. nom. sg. relative of a thing, subject of ἐστι: ’that which, whatever’ (ὃ κάλλιστον … ἐστι ’the one that is fairest’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄνομ: ὄνομα — name; neut. nom. sg., elided (ὄνομ’ = ὄνομα), subject of λίπηται: ’his name’
ὄπιδα: ὄπις — regard (for the gods), fear of divine retribution; fem. acc. sg.
ὄρηται: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, arise; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., without ἄν/κε after εἰ
ὄρχαμος: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader; masc. nom. sg. (ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν ’chief of men’)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὑπέρτερα: ὑπέρτερος — higher, upper; neut. acc. pl., of meat: ’the upper (outer) flesh’
ὑπερμενέων: ὑπερμενής — of exceeding might, overweening; masc. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
ὑπερφιάλοισι: ὑπερφίαλος — overbearing, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’ · also as a preverb apart from its verb (tmesis): φυγὼν ὕπο = ὑποφυγών ’having escaped’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ ’having escaped the pitiless day’) · also + gen. of agent, postpositive: Κικόνων ὕπο ’at the hands of the Cicones’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
